description: A heavy silver ring set with lapis lazuli, spelled by the witch Ayana a thousand years ago so that the Originals could walk in the sun.  The M engraved inside is worn almost smooth.  Take it off in daylight and you burn.

Charcoal wool, hand-tailored in London, with a waistcoat and a silk lining.  You've fought in it, fed in it and torn hearts out in it, and the tailor has never once asked about the stains.  It is, somehow, still immaculate.
A folded square of white silk.  You keep it for wiping blood from your hands after the unpleasant parts of the evening.  You have gone through a great many of them.
A fine leather journal, half full of your careful handwriting.  You've kept one every year for a millennium.
Brittle vellum bound in wood and hide, written in Old Norse.  The oldest of your journals.  <color_light_green>(Use it to read it.)</color>

description: An ornate silver dagger, its blade dulled with white oak ash.  Driven into an Original's heart, it puts them into a dead sleep until someone pulls it out.  Your family has used these on each other for a thousand years.
A stake carved from the last of the white oak.  The only thing in the world that can kill an Original, including you.  You hid it so well that you sometimes worry you'll forget where.  You never do.
A fire-hardened stake of ordinary ash wood.  It kills ordinary vampires.  It can't kill an Original.
A sealed glass vial of dark blood labelled "PETROVA".  The one thing your brother needs to break his curse.
A brass nameplate engraved with one of your siblings' names.

A bloody severed head violently torn from the shoulders of its victim with thousand-year-old Original force.  Warm residual blood still drips from the ragged neck stump.  Activate ('a') to drain its remaining blood (+60 to +100 mL) or brandish it as a grisly trophy.
